title: Safety Panel: Exposure Wizard with Rollback Script Editor
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a compact, non-technical 'Safety Panel' for the Redwood Console that guides product managers and SREs through a staged exposure (canary/A-B/rollout) using an interactive wizard. The panel includes a live user-impact projection graph, cost delta estimate, cohort selector, and an embedded 'Rollback Script Editor' that generates copy-paste safe runbook snippets (CLI + Console steps) for rapid mitigation. The goal is to reduce time-to-decision during rollouts by surfacing clear, actionable signals and pre-authorized rollback steps while keeping the UI approachable for non-engineering stakeholders.
acceptance_criteria: Hi-fi prototype (Figma) of Safety Panel flows: Setup -> Preview -> Activate -> In-flight -> Rollback
Interactive projected impact chart that shows Conversion/Latency/Error delta for selected cohorts and traffic percentages
Cost delta estimate displayed with token-level and hourly cost projections for chosen rollout duration
Rollback Script Editor that exports a formatted runbook (Console step + CLI + Slack escalation snippet) and supports one-click copy
Keyboard & screen-reader accessible controls (aria-live announcements for state changes, focus management for modal wizard), validated in accessibility pass
Design handoff tokens and documented component behavior for ENG implementation ticket ENG-50122
UX copy and microcopy finalized and approved by PM and Engs for safety-critical wording
design_notes: We prioritize a single-column compact layout so the panel can be used as a slide-over on top of existing dashboards
Projection model: simple linear interpolation + historical smoothing using last 7/30 day windows. Explicitly note uncertainty bounds and show worst-case/median/best-case curves
Cost estimate intentionally conservative (+10% buffer) to avoid underestimating spend impact for customers during demos
Rollback Script Editor is not an execution engine — it produces step-by-step mitigation actions and suggested model re-routing config; execution will remain with Dedicated/Private control-plane APIs
Trade-off: showing too many metrics increases cognitive load. MVP will show 3 signals (latency p95, error rate, primary business conversion) and link to deeper telemetry
Design must support customers with regulated environments: hide sampling/cohort names that might leak PII and provide masked cohort view
review_feedback: PM (Julian Meyer): prefer stronger framing for 'what-if' vs 'predicted' language; customers misinterpret deterministic forecasts
Eng (Priya Rao): ensure Projection queries are cheap; prototype should come with a fallback stubbed dataset to avoid backend load during demos
Security (Marco Li): add note to docs about no sensitive data in exported runbooks; add audit log hook for runbook generation
Design Review (Kenji Tanaka): suggested color palette adjustments for color-blind accessibility; use pattern + color for traffic bands
UX Research (Renee Owens): request 3 remote usability sessions with PM/SE personas before finalizing microcopy
